points.description: First valid reason for charge on colloidal particles (any one of: ionisation of surface active sites such as OH/COOH groups depending on pH; imperfection in crystal structure, e.g. lower-valency atoms replacing silicon giving net negative charge; adsorption of ions/anions onto the particle surface). Equivalent wording accepted.
Second, different valid reason from the same list. Must be distinct from the first reason.
